summary: Aermotor LS-40, 100 ft tower in Simpson County, administered by Mississippi Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered May 2026. Build date and condition not in sources read.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register May 19, 2026

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap tags tower as observation type

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 530 ft (162 m); OpenStreetMap gives 157 m. The story uses the register figure and notes the gap.

notes_for_editor: Sparse record. Build date, staffing, fires, condition and access are not documented in any source read. A Simpson County Historical & Genealogical Society Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet, says three 100 ft Mississippi Forestry Commission towers in Simpson County went up in 1958-59. Not used: the post could not be read (fetch_text and WebFetch returned only the title) and the snippet cannot be checked. If that post or an MFC report can be read, it would supply the build date. The brief's status 'standing' is not confirmed by any source read; the only dated event is the 2026 NHLR registration. OpenStreetMap elevation (157 m) differs from NHLR (162 m); both are noted. Checked 2026-10-09: the no-construction-date, no-hours/access and no-condition statements were read against the full NHLR page and OSM node text; an absence has no quote, so they carry no evidence entry.
